page.layout: One page of text, single column; a brace-marked conjugation scheme ("fatto") at the right of the text lines, no margin notes.

main_text.p: Che tu faresti, daß du theteft, machetest.
Che colui farebbe & faria, daß er thete, machete.
Che noi faremmo, daß wir theten, macheten.
Che voi fareste, daß jhr thetet, daß jhr machtet vnd machetet.
Coloro farebbono & fariano, daß sie theten, daß sie machten, vnd macheten.
main_text.head: Praeteritum perfectum.
main_text.p: Cum ego fecerim, tu feceris, ille fecerit.
O daß ich hab, gethan, gemacht, daß du habst gethan, gemacht, daß er hab gethan, gemacht.
main_text.head: Praeteritum plusq. perfect.

page.notes: Brace-marked groups in the scan were rendered as "}" with the shared word "fatto." or "gethan, gemacht." beside them; exact bracket shapes are approximate. Marginal ornament and stains ignored. The catchword "Vtinam" is at the foot right and is also reproduced as the last line; doubtful reading.
